description: The image displays four pie charts, each representing the distribution of response types for a different language model: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart is divided into segments corresponding to different categories of responses, with labels and percentages indicating the proportion of each type. For GPT4-o, the largest segment is "Lack of Knowledge" at 83.3%, followed by "Safety" at 16.7%. In the Gemini1.5-Pro chart, "Misinformation" is the largest category at 38.4%, followed by "Lack of Knowledge" at 22.1%, "Ethical Advice" at 16.3%, "Clarification" at 14.0%, and "Safety" at 9.3%. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart shows "Lack of Knowledge" at 75.0% and "Clarification" at 25.0%. For Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, the two categories, "Lack of Knowledge" and "Misinformation," are each at 50.0%. The charts use distinct colors for each category, and the percentages are clearly labeled within each slice. The overall layout presents a comparative analysis of how these models handle factual responses, with "Lack of Knowledge" being a dominant response across all models except for Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, where it is balanced with "Misinformation."
